[MOTIFS]
Venetian blinds diagonal crimson light bars across empty chair. One-way observation glass panel visible far wall. Brushed steel interrogation table reflecting ceiling fluorescent. Chinese regulation posters on concrete wall. Single overhead interrogation lamp creating cone of light.

[ACTION MOMENT]
Establishing wide of empty interrogation chamber: the cage before the occupants. Venetian blind slats cast red-gold diagonal bands across institutional-grey concrete. A single chrome interrogation table center-frame, its surface a mirror of cold fluorescent ceiling light. The one-way observation glass is visible background-right as a dark rectangular absence—a mirror that doesn't reflect. An empty chair waits at the near side. Far wall bears faded Chinese police procedure posters under a single warm pendant lamp. The composition frames waiting—the space is armed. Captured as if shot by Gregory Crewdson: suspended, architecturally violent, temporally frozen.

The black pencil skirt molds her thighs, sheer seamed stockings visible from mid-thigh downward, the stocking seam a dark line tracing toward black heels. One leg is crossed over the other; the top foot dangles with burgundy-tipped toenails catching amber rim-light. Her other hand rests flat on the cool metal table surface, fingers extended but not tensed. Venetian blind light bars fall across her body at a 45-degree angle—crimson and shadow stripes dividing her chest and face. Her head tilts slightly leftward, gaze directed not at the camera but at the empty chair opposite. The fluorescent ceiling reflects dully in the table. Behind her shoulder, out of focus: the dark one-way mirror panel where someone watches. This is the story-bearing shot. Medium captures her body language, outfit, face, and the interrogation space simultaneously. Captured as if shot by Wong Kar-wai: temporal hesitation made physical.
